  "source_quote": "SLLIS implements the Gomez and Gomez Dual Language Enrichment Model, which is a structured way to provide rigorous dual language instruction at the elementary level. The Language of the Day does not change the Language of Instruction, but it does change the language used for everyday interactions at school - recess, lunch, informal conversations - to the greatest extent possible.
